podcast.body: Released on August 10, 1996, "Until it Sleeps" holds a significant place in digital music history as the first MP3 file ever shared online. It was distributed by CDA (Compress to Audio), an offshoot of the Warez Scene dedicated to music piracy. "And the first MP3 ever shared was until it sleeps by Metallica. And it was August 10th, 1996."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall of the MP3

podcast.body: This unreleased song was shared online on August 12, 1996, by "Compressed to Audio," marking what is believed to be the very first shareable MP3. While it didn't cause significant damage at the time due to the infancy of MP3 file trading, it drew the band's attention to online distribution. "On August 12, 1996, an online outfit calling itself Compressed to Audio shared what we think was the very first Sherable MP3. To the best of anyone's knowledge, the first song uploaded and shared this way was Metallica's until its sleeps, a song that had yet to be released."
